item.text:
The recorded design has three samples in each condition: control and treated. `group` matches `condition` for every sample, and no batch, pairing, or other covariate is recorded. So the planned differential test can compare the two conditions, but it cannot account for unrecorded sources of variation. Whether the three samples per condition are independent biological replicates is not stated in the design; that affects how confidently you can interpret the test.
